authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL lists Hindi *bhaĩs/bhaĩsī*, Gujarati *bhẽś* and Old Marwari *bhaïṃsa/bhaïṃsi* under *mahiṣa*. These substantiate the characteristic mh > bh and contracted vowel outcomes. Comparative check: KochilaTharu bʰãisi “buffalo” (f_p2tj4xu7ap2uq). The exact survey spelling and phonetic marks remain untouched. Stress, vowel articulation, release marks and source palatal/sibilant notation were reviewed as local details; the full form and sense support the same family. The link does not settle uncertain transfer within Indo-Aryan.
